description: It reads one page of a webinar as a flat list of blocks from top to bottom: each block with its path, its type and the text or image that stands there now. Take it before a block is changed, because the change needs the path from here, and when a host asks what stands on their page. "What is on my registration page right now?" You pick the page, registration or thank you. It only reads and changes nothing. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: page blocks, registration page, thank you page, block path

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

surface.description: Which page to read. Default registration.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.
